about: The four entry kits of the case and how an Act 1 ending maps to one (package A3, decision D019). Server only, never served. The coins and the texts come from the S0 drafts (CASE-FILE.md section 3) and are PENDING Nils' approval of S0. This order is the case-file order, not the order in which NPC partners fill missing kits.

item.name: Keeper's permit
item.text: Opens the keepers' post room behind the Harbor Office.

item.name: Words through the door
item.text: What you heard the fisherman say into his radio, through the locked tower door. C2 is in your journal from the start.

item.name: The fisherman's red token
item.text: Opens the smugglers' back room at Smugglers' Cove.

item.name: A face nobody knows
item.text: Greyfathom's yard hires people who took no side. This kit also brings 600 extra coins.
